mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.2% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 5.2% in a single month
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.2% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST show positive growth in the same month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% month-over-month), manufacturing activity expansion supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% MoM, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 3.0% annualized, it signals strong economic momentum that boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0% annualized, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a manufacturing slowdown and labor market weakness, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: manufacturing contraction and labor market stress
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods where both INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
